repository.name: agid-postal-uz
repository.purpose: Uzbekistan postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.assignment_rule: The UPU Uzbekistan addressing sheet dated 07/2019 documents six digits before the locality. Its generic coding identifies a delivery post office or postal hub, regional centre or territory or town, and regional or provincial context; Tashkent uses a separate three-plus-three post-office coding method. Production assignment requires an exact current UzPost response or rights-cleared official release with postal object type, jurisdiction, validity, retrieval time, schema and digest pinned. A UPU example, old portal row, prefix, office point, address search, coordinate, model or third-party map does not create an assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A six-digit postal index is not guaranteed to be an area. Never generate official postal geometry from digits, delivery-office coverage, an office point, administrative containment, proximity, Voronoi, interpolation or a model. Official geometry requires an exact operator or competent-authority artifact explicitly relating the code to a point, polygon or multipolygon and pinning authority, object type, jurisdiction, validity, CRS, topology, licence and digest. Derived surfaces stay independently labelled.
postal_system.open_data_rule: The official 2019 open-data portal dataset is a dated list of branches, post offices and postal indices, not current assignment proof and not geometry. Portal terms permit reuse, modification and commercial use with lawful use, no distortion and source attribution, but the exact resource version, terms snapshot, provenance and digest must be pinned. The 2026 government open-data registry is discovery metadata, not a postal row or licence override.
postal_system.operator_map_rule: The current UzPost map provides operational address and index search and post-office categories. A pinned response may support a dated index-to-office or search relation only under exact service terms, privacy, retention, rate and display rights. Interactive access is not permission to harvest or republish a national address, customer, office-coverage or geometry corpus.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building or parcel geometry with purpose, authority, jurisdiction, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. Postcode, post-office assignment or point, map search, cadastral parcel, property-register result, administrative polygon, coordinate, road, OSM footprint or proximity is not an automatic address-building relation.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Postal indices, permitted office or address points, official or derived surfaces and buildings may link to AGID cells through explicit versioned crosswalks without relabelling a postal index, office, address, building, parcel, administrative area or territory as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is UzPost geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Current UzPost public pages do not by themselves grant bulk address, assignment, geometry or redistribution rights. The old official open-data portal terms apply only to portal open data and require attribution and no distortion. Cadastre and state-register materials require exact resource access, rights and privacy review; government-site attribution text is not a blanket data licence. ODbL data remains separate. Pin every exact resource, terms version, override and digest before promotion.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Address and index searches, residential-registration and state real-estate records, cadastral identifiers, exact coordinates, entrances, units, recipients, residents, owners, occupants, accounts and query logs may expose household, property or personal context. They are excluded from public artifacts unless lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are explicit.
postal_system.temporal_rule: Postal-index assignments, post offices, addresses, coordinates, administrative context, buildings and crosswalks are time-dependent. Store valid_from, valid_to, observed_at, retrieved_at, source version and supersession independently; the dated 2019 list and a current lookup must not overwrite one another or rewrite historical evidence.
postal_system.territorial_rule: Country code UZ selects a runtime and source contract; it is not a sovereignty, jurisdiction, administrative-boundary or universal-coverage assertion. Republic, province or city, district, locality, language, source authority, jurisdiction, validity and licence must be explicit. No postal, government, cadastral, third-party or community source is presumed to cover every area or settle boundary status.
